absent: Full memory layout of address space, folio, readahead control, file readahead state, and backing device structures beyond observed fields.
Lock ordering and interrupt safety across host lock, cache lock, invalidation lock, and reclamation vector lock beyond shown acquisitions.
Behaviour of filesystem read and batched read operations, memory control charging, working set tracking, and block merging scopes invoked but not defined here.
Complete error code set and retry policy for cache insertion beyond no memory versus already present handling.
Lifecycle and sizing rules for shadow entries, large swap entry splitting limits, and direct access mappings beyond the shown branches.
Selection rules between queued and immediate activation builds and generational tuning thresholds.

findings.text: Forced cache population caps the requested amount to the larger of device optimal transfer size and configured window, splits large requests into bounded chunks, and does nothing when the address space offers neither single nor batched read operations.

Size bounded helper derives the final cache index from host size, skips empty files and start positions beyond content, trims overlong requests to the last byte, and suppresses the lookahead marker when the end is reached.
Bounded helper holds mapping invalidation protection in shared mode across the unbounded population call, and the unbounded routine requires that shared protection to be held by its caller.

Unbounded population aligns the start to mapping constraints, computes a marker offset for the asynchronous region, preallocates missing folios at minimum order, flushes accumulated batches on present entries or insertion conflicts, flags the marker folio, tracks refault evidence, suppresses filesystem reclamation during allocation, and leaves input output failures for later single reads.

Cache insertion wrapper charges the folio to memory control with root substitution for kernel files, locks it, delegates to the low level inserter, and on success handles refault activation for non write allocations, joins reclamation lists, and accounts kernel resident pages, unwinding charge and lock on failure.

Low level insertion expects a locked file folio satisfying minimum order and alignment, elevates its reference count, links mapping and position, merges with shadow state while splitting oversized shadow ranges except for memory backed filesystems where it aborts, updates residency and transparent huge counters, and on failure detaches the mapping while preserving position for truncation and dropping added references.

Shadow tracking configuration enables node update and reclamation list callbacks only for ordinary mappings, excluding direct access and memory backed mappings identified by operations pointer equality.

Reclamation list joining rejects folios already queued or simultaneously active and unevictable, applies fault time promotion for working set and referenced state when generational reclamation is active outside atomic allocation, then buffers the folio in a per processor batch whose locking depends on operation kind.

Access marking leaves dropbehind folios cold, delegates to generational reference counting when enabled, otherwise moves from unreferenced to referenced and then toward active through queued or in batch activation with reference clearing and working set notification, treats unevictable and already active as hot, and clears idle state while reporting cold.

Two activation variants share the precondition of inactive reclaimable queued folios, one deferring movement through a per processor queue and the other performing immediate locked transfer between reclamation lists with accounting and tracing.

In batch activation scans only the local processor queue under local protection to avoid races with remote drain reclaim migration or release, while immediate activation clears queue membership before taking the reclamation vector lock and restores membership after release.

Generational reference accounting reports unevictable as hot, promotes first touch to referenced and cold, saturates a small counter then transitions to working set on overflow, while the disabled build always reports cold without state change.

Batch submission does nothing when empty, brackets work with memory pressure and block merging scopes when refault evidence exists, prefers vector read when offered with removal unlocking and release of leftovers, otherwise issues single reads, and requires an empty residual batch on exit.

Removal from cache requires the folio to be locked, serializes against lookup and truncation with host and cache locks, optionally returns the host to shrinkable reclamation, and finally invokes the optional free hook before dropping page references.

Deletion replaces the cache entry with optional shadow state, detaches the mapping while retaining position for truncation lookup, decrements residency, and adjusts file shared memory and transparent huge counters with special handling that exempts huge table folios and accounts kernel files.

Removing a still mapped or dirty folio signals a defect with warnings and taint, with a narrow mitigation that can reset mapping counts and references for small folios in exiting mappings, and dirty state is normalized through clean accounting on writeback capable mappings.

Unlock clears the locked state and wakes waiters only when waiter evidence exists, using a hashed global wait table and serialized wakeup that can leave stale waiter evidence for a later waker when the queue remains active for other folios.
Readahead allocation creates folios at mapping minimum order with caller supplied allocation scope and propagates dropbehind intent to newly created folios.

Range invalidation collects locked present entries and shadow values across the interval, attempts eviction with unlock, deactivates busy survivors while counting failures separately from evicted pages, purges shadow ranges when values were seen, releases batch references, and yields scheduling between batches while relying on stable position during deletion.

Locked scan under read side protection skips large folios and multislot values that start early or extend past the interval, requires successful nonblocking lock with continued mapping association and absence of writeback, records source positions, stops when the batch fills, and releases references for skipped or rejected entries.

Cache lookup helper retries on transient index state, returns absent and shadow or special values without reference elevation, otherwise elevates the reference and revalidates identity against the index before returning, restarting on race.

Observed cache state includes mapping residency count flags host operations and page tree, folio linkage to mapping with position order and flag state, and readahead cursor with batch count working set evidence and dropbehind mode.
Forced population uses a two megabyte chunk size scaled by page size as the maximum per iteration unit.
Folio unlock build checks assume waiter indication at bit seven and locked indication at or below bit seven to permit byte sign inspection on one architecture.
